description: Original numeric metrics only; unmodified external theme sources, rendered HTML/CSS, source text, logs and private filesystem paths are omitted.
notes: Descriptive percentile bootstrap across independent process/batch medians; shared hardware, scheduler, GC/JIT and system load are not controlled. Affinity is not isolation.

Serial randomized rounds and variants; seven independent warm processes per variant, 50 excluded warmup requests and 30 measured requests per process. Every warmup/sample and cold output was checked against the independent original Ruby oracle.
Warm complete request rendering includes fresh request state and HTML/CSS assembly, with source/schema/AST caches retained; hashing and report/artifact writes are excluded.
Cold includes process startup, dependencies, validation, initial parsing/rendering, output/report writes and exit; ordinary filesystem caches are not flushed.

Ruby cold includes bundled dependency activation and Git provenance validation inside the process; Rust source provenance is checked by the parent. Cold is a CLI comparison, not equal-work engine startup.
Fiber creates/resumes one request Fiber on one thread with no scheduler or CPU parallelism.
GNU time was unavailable; Ruby worker VmHWM is available at report time, while Rust peak RSS/CPU/allocations are unavailable. No cross-engine memory ranking is supported.
This is one bounded synthetic homepage with fixture-specific platform adapters; it is not universal Liquid or Shopify performance.
